source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (DBIE) - raw/ tables only
note: Checks compare RBC-published totals against each other (accounting identities), against a second RBI feed, or a published figure against one recomputed from the index. An indicator marked single-source has one cell in one table and no second witness; that is stated rather than dressed up as a check.

checks.description: currency with public + demand + time + other deposits = M3
net bank credit to govt + credit to commercial sector + net FX assets + govt currency liability - non-monetary liabilities = M3
(currency with public + demand deposits + other deposits with RBI) + time deposits = M3
currency in circulation + bankers' deposits + other deposits = reserve money
net RBI credit to govt + RBI credit to banks & commercial sector + net FX assets + govt currency liabilities - non-monetary liabilities = reserve money
food credit + non-food credit = bank credit
demand deposits + time deposits = aggregate deposits
government securities + other approved securities = investments
notes in circulation + notes held in the banking department = notes issued
double entry: liabilities total and assets total both equal the published total
each tenor total = banks + primary dealers + state govts + others
weekly WSS policy repo rate = key-rates snapshot
weekly WSS cash reserve ratio = key-rates snapshot
weekly WSS statutory liquidity ratio = key-rates snapshot
weekly WSS INR/US$ = portal daily FBIL reference rate
checks.detail: different observation dates (2026-10-16 weekly vs 2026-10-15 daily) - values 95.0200 vs 95.0691, consistent

checks.description: RBI's published CPI inflation = the figure recomputed from the CPI index

wpi.note: computed from the WPI index; no published growth series in the tables we fetch

cdr.note: ratio of credit to deposits; both inputs are identity-verified, the division is not

liquidity.note: 22-working-day mean of net LAF; the mean is arithmetic, the input is single-source

callmoney.note: one cell in the weekly WSS table (weighted-average call rate)

gsec.note: one cell in the weekly WSS table (10-year par yield)

cdout.note: one cell in the CD table (amount outstanding)

cpout.note: one cell in the CP table (amount outstanding)

turnover.note: sum of five columns in the money-market turnover table; no second witness

yld91.note: one cell in the weekly WSS table (91-day T-bill primary yield)

fwd3m.note: one cell in the weekly WSS table (3-month forward premia)

wpifuel.note: computed from a WPI component index; component weights are published outside DBIE

wpimanu.note: computed from a WPI component index; component weights are published outside DBIE

wpiprim.note: computed from a WPI component index; component weights are published outside DBIE

cpirural.note: computed from the CPI rural index; weights are published outside DBIE

cpiurban.note: computed from the CPI urban index; weights are published outside DBIE

moneymult.note: M3 / reserve money; both inputs are identity-verified, the division is not

rbicredit.note: net RBI credit to the Centre - a sub-line of a verified parent, not verified itself

termspread.note: 10y G-sec minus 91-day T-bill; both inputs are single-source
